record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
record.context_brief: Constructing non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measures on a topological attractor
record.original_question: Let Λ = ⋂_{n≥0} f^n(U) be a topological attractor with trapping region U for a diffeomorphism f. Under what conditions can one construct a Milnor attractor A contained in Λ by producing a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure supported on Λ via the SRB construction discussed in the paper?

evidence.quote: 1. Given a topological attractor Λ, when can we construct a Milnor attractor A ⊂ Λ by the above method? That is, how do we obtain a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure on Λ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold and let $f: M \to M$ be a $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphism. A non-empty open set $U \subset M$ with $\overline{f(U)} \subset U$ is called a trapping region, and the corresponding topological attractor is
$$\Lambda \;=\; \bigcap_{n\ge 0} f^n(U).$$
A Milnor attractor is a compact invariant set $A \subset M$ such that its basin
$$B(A) \;=\; \{x \in M : \omega_f(x) \subset A\}$$
has positive Lebesgue measure, and no proper compact invariant subset of $A$ has the same property up to a null set.

An $f$-invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ supported on $\Lambda$ is said to be a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure if (i) all Lyapunov exponents of $\mu$ are nonzero (some positive and some negative on a set of full $\mu$-measure when $\dim M \ge 2$, allowing mixed signs), and (ii) the conditional measures of $\mu$ on local unstable manifolds are absolutely continuous with respect to the induced Lebesgue measure on those manifolds.

Problem. Identify general geometric and dynamical conditions on the pair $(f,U)$ — and hence on the topological attractor $\Lambda$ — under which there exists a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure $\mu$ supported on $\Lambda$, and such that the support (or some appropriate minimal "observed" invariant subset) of $\mu$ is a Milnor attractor $A \subset \Lambda$. In particular, give verifiable sufficient conditions on $f|_U$ that allow one to construct such an SRB measure on $\Lambda$ by pushing forward and averaging Lebesgue measure on $U$ along the orbits of $f$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a survey of open problems on non-uniform hyperbolicity. While significant progress on constructing SRB measures for non-uniformly hyperbolic systems has been made (e.g., by Pesin, Climenhaga, Dolgopyat, Sarig, and others under specific structural assumptions such as the presence of hyperbolic periodic points with horseshoes, dominated splittings, or Young towers), no general criterion characterizing when an arbitrary topological attractor carries a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure has been established. The problem remains open in full generality.
